source: FDA Oncology Package Inserts & Clinical Pharmacology Formulary

drugs.name: Osimertinib
drugs.renal_adjustment: No dose adjustment required for mild to moderate renal impairment; monitor if Cr > 2.0.
drugs.hepatic_adjustment: Withhold if ALT/AST > 5x ULN; resume at 40 mg upon recovery to Grade <= 1.
critical_contraindications: Concurrent strong CYP3A4 inducers (Rifampin, St. John's Wort)
drugs.expected_benefit: Median PFS 18.9 months; high CNS penetrance.

drugs.name: Sotorasib
drugs.hepatic_adjustment: Hold for Grade >= 2 liver transaminase elevation (ALT/AST > 3x ULN).
critical_contraindications: Concomitant acid-reducing agents without timing separation
drugs.expected_benefit: Overall response rate 37.1%; disease control rate 80.6%.

drugs.name: Pembrolizumab
drugs.standard_dose: 200 mg IV Q3W or 400 mg IV Q6W
drugs.renal_adjustment: Hold for immune-mediated nephritis (Cr > 1.5x baseline); permanent discontinuation if Cr > 3x.
drugs.hepatic_adjustment: Withhold for Grade 2 hepatitis (ALT/AST 3-5x ULN). Permanent discontinuation for ALT/AST > 5x.
critical_contraindications: Severe active autoimmune disease requiring systemic immunosuppression
drugs.expected_benefit: Durable immune control; 5-year OS benefit in PD-L1 positive tumors.

drugs.name: Carboplatin + Pemetrexed
drugs.standard_dose: Carboplatin AUC 5 + Pemetrexed 500 mg/m2 IV Q3W
drugs.renal_adjustment: Contraindicated if CrCl < 45 mL/min (Pemetrexed excretion impaired).
drugs.expected_benefit: Established standard second-line salvage; overall response rate 30-35%.

drugs.name: Olaparib
drugs.renal_adjustment: Reduce to 200 mg BID for CrCl 31-50 mL/min; contraindicated if CrCl <= 30.
drugs.hepatic_adjustment: Monitor closely in moderate hepatic impairment.
drugs.expected_benefit: Significant PFS prolongation in BRCA-mutated malignancies.
